name: add-coverage
description: Automated test coverage workflow for .NET projects. Finds the highest-CRAP untested method, writes a mutation-validated xUnit test, reviews it, commits, and opens a PR — all in one command.

commands.name: add-coverage
commands.description: Find a coverage gap, write a test, validate it catches regressions, review it, commit, and open a PR.

agents.name: coverage-gap-finder
agents.description: Runs the build-test-coverage pipeline and identifies the single highest-CRAP untested method.

agents.name: test-author
agents.description: Writes a new xUnit test targeting the coverage gap from gap-report.md.

agents.name: mutation-validator
agents.description: Validates the new test catches breaking changes via Stryker.NET or manual mutation.

agents.name: test-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews the new test file for quality and convention adherence.

skills.name: crap-analysis
skills.description: CRAP score interpretation, coverage.runsettings setup, and ReportGenerator usage.

skills.name: test-authoring
skills.description: xUnit test conventions: naming, Shouldly assertions, NSubstitute mocking, fixture patterns.

skills.name: stryker-dotnet
skills.description: Stryker.NET mutation testing: installation, scoped invocation, JSON output parsing.
